extracted.intended_audience: prospective Echoing Green Fellowship applicants / social entrepreneurs seeking seed funding and support
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and selection criteria for applicants to the Echoing Green full-time Fellowship for social impact leaders; describes who they seek, what qualities matter, and what supports Fellows receive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact ambition / scope of plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Find people working on plans to make the world better in a big way.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Echoing Green seeks applicants whose ideas aim for large-scale social change rather than small or narrowly scoped projects. The Fellowship is positioned to support ideas intended to address major problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-rooted knowledge and passion
rubrics_metrics.description: Leaders who bring deep knowledge and passion to designing solutions with and for their communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should demonstrate that their solutions are developed with community involvement and that they possess lived experience or deep understanding of the communities they serve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transformational leadership / challenging the status quo
rubrics_metrics.description: Leaders who challenge the status quo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Echoing Green prioritizes transformational leaders who push beyond incremental change and question existing systems and structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advancement of equity and issue-area relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Work that advances equity across issue areas, including education, climate justice, human rights, health, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fellowship supports a broad set of issue areas but centers equity; applicants should show how their work contributes to equitable outcomes within their chosen domain(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek out overlooked places / geographic & network equity
rubrics_metrics.description: Prioritize funding leaders and communities less likely to connect with traditional investment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants from underserved geographies, communities, or networks that are often overlooked by conventional funders are explicitly prioritized; outreach and selection are designed to find talent outside usual investment pipelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include all kinds of talent / demographic and experiential diversity
rubrics_metrics.description: Cultivate a diverse network of social impact talent across a breadth of ethnic, gender, religious, and economic backgrounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program values diversity of background and experience; selection favors inclusive representation across multiple demographic and socioeconomic axes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate potential in new ways / non-traditional indicators of leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows are more than their business plans—so focus on indicators of lifelong leadership, looking beyond traditional benchmarks such as previous financial success or business school degrees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection criteria intentionally de-emphasize conventional credentials and past financial metrics; assessors look for evidence of long-term leadership potential, resilience, commitment, and other non-traditional signals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seed funding terms (capital)
rubrics_metrics.description: A stipend over 18 months (100,000 USD). Funding offered to for-profit organizations is in the form of recoverable grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should expect a stipend of $100,000 distributed over 18 months; for-profit entities receive funding as recoverable grants rather than unconditional grants—understand the financial terms when applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity building (program offering)
rubrics_metrics.description: A comprehensive program to build and grow leadership skills and develop the strategies needed for ideas to thrive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellows receive structured capacity-building support to strengthen organizational and leadership capabilities; applicants should be ready to engage in developmental programming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership development (program offering)
rubrics_metrics.description: Leadership Development: a comprehensive program to build and grow leadership skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fellowship provides targeted leadership training and development; potential Fellows are expected to participate in such programming to scale their impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellness and wellbeing support
rubrics_metrics.description: Ongoing support focuses on mental and emotional wellbeing along with self-care workshops designed specifically for the struggles of entrepreneurship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Echoing Green offers wellness resources recognizing the pressures of social entrepreneurship; applicants should be prepared to engage with wellbeing supports as part of the Fellowship experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert resources & pro-bono support
rubrics_metrics.description: A suite of pro-bono support from leading professionals to build organizational capacity and help navigate the social innovation field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellows gain access to experts and pro-bono services; applicants may leverage these resources to accelerate organizational development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community and convenings
rubrics_metrics.description: Virtual and In-Person Convenings: Gatherings to connect Fellows within and across classes, regions, and communities to build strong ties among Fellows over their entrepreneurial journey.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Community-building is central; selected Fellows should expect to participate in cohort-based convenings and networking opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities to connect with experienced business leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunities to connect with experienced business leaders committed to supporting positive social change globally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fellowship facilitates mentorship and connections to business leaders; applicants can anticipate access to strategic advisors and supporters.
